english: A powered pressure plate. Step on it and it repairs every damaged block in the land claim it sits in (yours or an ally's).\nRepairs use materials from Repair Supply Chests in the same claim first, then repair kits. No other storage is touched. If supplies run short it repairs what it can, most damaged first, and tells you what is missing.
Holds the materials and repair kits a Repair Pad uses.\nPlace it anywhere inside the same land claim as the pad. Close it before you step on the pad, or the pad skips it.
